title: Corporate Counsel
description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full. How you'll make impact As Corporate Counsel, you’ll support Airwallex’s growth in the UK by providing practical, business-focused legal advice on corporate, regulatory and commercial matters. You’ll work closely with Corporate Development on strategic transactions such as fundraising and M&A, partner with UK and regional leaders on new-market entry, support licence expansion, and help align Airwallex’s global policies and governance with UK and relevant EMEA requirements. You’ll also advise on marketing, referral and partnership initiatives, helping the business move quickly while managing legal and regulatory risk. Provide clear, pragmatic advice on UK and relevant EMEA legal and regulatory requirements, helping teams navigate applicable rules while enabling responsible growth. Support Corporate Development on fundraising rounds and strategic transactions, including due diligence, data rooms, corporate approvals, investment documentation, cap table changes and ongoing governance. Partner with the business, Regulatory Legal and Regulatory Compliance teams on expansion into and launches in new markets across the UK and EMEA, including regulatory mapping, entity and licensing considerations, and corporate governance requirements. Align Airwallex’s policies, procedures and corporate governance frameworks across jurisdictions, with particular focus on UK requirements. Draft, review and negotiate referral agreements, marketing and sponsorship agreements, and other commercial arrangements, ensuring risks are appropriately managed and documented. Advise on marketing, advertising and promotions, including claims, disclosures, digital campaigns, co-marketing and referral programmes, while supporting the review of customer-facing materials for legal and regulatory compliance. Coordinate and manage outside counsel on specialised matters in the UK and across EMEA, ensuring advice is high-quality, cost-effective and aligned to Airwallex’s risk appetite and business goals. Use technology and AI-enabled tools, including templates, playbooks, contract lifecycle tools and knowledge bases, to increase the speed, consistency and quality of legal work. You’ll work from our London office three days a week. What we're looking for Essentials Qualification as a solicitor or barrister in England and Wales, or an equivalent qualification in another UK jurisdiction, and in good standing with the relevant professional body. Proven experience in financial services and corporate law, preferably gained at a fast-growing technology or fintech company and/or a top-tier law firm. Demonstrated interest in financial services regulation and the fintech industry, with willingness to go deep on payments, e-money, money services and related regulatory topics in the UK and EMEA. In-depth knowledge of, or strong familiarity with, the UK legal and business environment, including how UK legislation, FCA requirements and cross-border rules impact fintech and payments businesses. Proven experience drafting and negotiating corporate and commercial agreements, with strong written and verbal communication skills that make complex issues clear to non-lawyers. Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including Corporate Development, Finance, Product, Compliance, Risk and Marketing, across time zones. Demonstrated capability in managing and leading outside counsel, including scoping work, controlling costs and consolidating advice into clear recommendations. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a practical, business-oriented approach and comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Preferred Experience supporting fundraising transactions, M&A or strategic investments, including due diligence and deal execution, ideally in a technology or fintech context. Prior in-house experience in a fintech, payments or broader financial services company, particularly one operating across the UK and multiple EMEA jurisdictions. Experience advising on legal issues related to marketing, advertising and promotions, including digital marketing, performance marketing, referral programmes and brand partnerships. Exposure to UK financial services regulatory frameworks, including the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000, the Payment Services Regulations 2017, the Electronic Money Regulations 2011, FCA rules and guidance, and applicable financial promotions requirements. Experience partnering with Regulatory Legal, Regulatory Compliance or licensing teams on market expansion initiatives and regulatory change. Comfort using technology, AI and legal operations tools to increase the speed and quality of legal work, for example playbooks, templates, contract lifecycle tools or knowledge bases. You'll thrive here if You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken. You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway. You have experience at a fintech, payments company, or other highly regulated business. You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect. You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details. Learn more about your team Legal sits at the heart of the decisions that shape how Airwallex grows. This team backs the builders transforming us into a generational financial company, working alongside product, sales, and business partners every step of the way. You'll help shape a global licensing footprint most fintechs wish they had, while keeping our brand and data architecture best-in-class for customers entering the agentic economy and its regulatory demands. The hard part is helping the business move fast on product, revenue, and new-market expansion without compromising the discipline that protects the moat. It's a team for lawyers, strategists, and licensing specialists with commercial instincts, sharp judgment, and an obsession with customer-first outcomes. If you want to guide executive decisions and help build the licensing, structure, and judgment behind what comes next, this is where legal has real leverage. You will direct and mentor, and you will also design, setting the visual benchmark yourself, not just reviewing other people's work against it. You will work in close partnership with our VP of Product Design, so that the brand reads as one across marketing, product, and the entire brand experience. title: Tech Lead
description: We’re on a mission to protect society from fraud and money laundering. We’ve already protected over 3 million people through life’s big transactions. Fraud and regulation are rising, costing the UK economy over £100bn every year; this makes it more difficult for businesses to protect themselves and their clients - individuals like you and me - from fraud and money laundering. Our co-founders Olly and Jack were led to this area when a friend was defrauded of £25K when buying their first property. At the time, anti-fraud technology didn’t exist, which meant that completing the anti-fraud checks required in these processes was largely manual. These big life moments should be exciting, but instead are often confusing and scary due to the painful process of completing these paper-based checks and the risk of fraud. Thirdfort helps businesses to facilitate these anti fraud checks so that individuals know they can transact safely and seamlessly with professionals during these big transactions. Our anti-fraud platform provides a secure way for professionals in regulated sectors like Lawyers, Estate Agents and Accountants to transfer funds and verify sensitive information through app based document checks, facial recognition and open banking. Over 1,500 businesses now trust Thirdfort to verify their clients. We are FCA regulated and have raised over \$33m in capital from leading Fintech investors Breega and Element Ventures, as well as the founders of Zoopla, Funding Circle, Comply Advantage, Tessian, Fenergo and Fidel. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex problems , owning technical direction within a domain, and helping other engineers grow through mentorship and example. description:
<p>At Hudson River Trading (HRT) the Applied AI team’s mission is to increase the speed and quality of work across the firm’s most consequential workflows. We build AI systems that help researchers and developers iterate faster, automate increasingly complex work, and enable autonomous exploration at a scale that would not otherwise be possible.</p> <p>We apply frontier models and agentic systems to how quantitative research, software development, and other critical work at HRT gets done. We combine cutting-edge commercial and open-source models and tools with infrastructure, research, and systems of our own.</p> <p>Our work spans the full stack required to make this successful: AI infrastructure, research engineering, post-training and reinforcement learning, agent evaluation, security and alignment, and deployment into real workflows.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>Depending on your experience and interests, your work may include:</p> <ul> <li>Building scalable infrastructure for training, evaluating, and operating model and agent capabilities through post-training, reinforcement learning, prompting, tool design, and workflow optimization</li> <li>Designing sandboxing, policy enforcement, monitoring, and other safeguards for increasingly capable autonomous systems</li> <li>Partnering with teams across HRT to identify work AI can newly perform, develop effective solutions, and turn successful experiments establishing effective practices for building and working with AI across HRT</li> </ul> <p><strong>Profile</strong></p> <ul> <li>You are an excellent engineer who can turn ambiguous problems into working systems</li> <li>You learn unfamiliar technical and business domains quickly and enjoy moving between them</li> <li>You care about advancing what AI systems can reliably accomplish</li> title: Senior Staff Product Engineer
description: About hyperexponential (hx) At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms. Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence. Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx. What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates. What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next. About the Engineering team At hyperexponential, engineering is at the heart of our mission to transform the insurance industry. Our engineers build and scale, enabling insurers to model complex risks and make smarter pricing decisions at speed. By combining deep technical expertise with creativity, the team pushes the boundaries of what’s possible in insurance technology. Within engineering, our product teams are cross-functional, pairing frontend and backend engineers with designers and product managers. This enables end-to-end ownership of features, with engineers contributing across design, architecture, implementation, and testing. Collaboration is a core part of how we work, ensuring that every release is both technically sound and valuable to our users. How we work We're in the middle of a deliberate shift in how hx builds. Everyone in product development is a Builder , and the Product Engineer is the default unit of how we work. We organise around problems, not permanent teams. Small pods , usually of two to four Product Engineers, form around the highest-value problem, own it end-to-end from discovery through to running it in production, and re-form as priorities change. Pods sit inside value streams, each owning a customer outcome and led by a Stream Lead who decides which problems the stream takes on and holds the bar for what ships. Your growth sits elsewhere: a Career Mentor owns your development and progression, so you can move to where the most important problem is without your career following the org chart. We hire Product Engineers into hx, not into a fixed team, domain, or layer of the stack. You'll start in the stream where your strengths and our highest-value problems meet, and move as the problems move. Product Engineers are T-shaped: deep expertise in software engineering, plus enough product and design judgement to make routine calls yourself. An embedded PM or designer raises a pod's ceiling on the hardest problems, but is never a gate between you and the customer. This is also a deliberately AI-native role, and one of the areas where we're moving fastest. A pod of three owns its problem whole, which means going wherever it leads: front end, back end, data, or infrastructure. You don't need to be full-stack by trade, but you do need to be comfortable working outside your strongest layer. The Product Engineer role is the same at every level. What scales is the size of the problem you own, how expensive your decisions are to reverse, and how far your judgement travels beyond your pod. At Level 5 , that looks like this. What you'll be doing Taking a customer problem from discovery to production inside a pod, getting close to customers yourself, framing the problem, and shipping in small increments guided by real customer signal rather than internal opinion. Directing AI agents to draft implementation, tests, and migrations, then reviewing, integrating, and hardening that work. You'll write intent precisely enough to brief both a teammate and an agent, and own correctness and maintainability regardless of how the first draft was produced. Designing and delivering robust production systems where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency matter, with the tests and observability that make complex behaviour safe to evolve. Working across the codebase wherever the problem leads, including areas your pod doesn't steward, with stewards looped in proportionate to the risk rather than handing work off and waiting. Moving between pods, problems, and streams as priorities change, ramping fast on unfamiliar domains and leaving what you built running well behind you. Taking full accountability for outcomes rather than just your code changes: raising risks early, and deciding rather than escalating. What you'll need to have done Built and shipped production systems end-to-end, from design through rollout, monitoring, and iteration, in settings where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency mattered. Designed testing and observability that made complex behaviour understandable, debuggable, and safe to evolve. Worked effectively in a polyglot environment, choosing the right tool for the problem and picking up unfamiliar languages, domains, and codebases fast. Strong systems experience, for example in Rust, C/C++, or Python, is valued, and we'll upskill you where there are gaps. Shipped work outside your strongest layer of the stack when the problem needed it, picking up the front end, the data layer, or the infrastructure rather than waiting for someone else to. Used AI tools as a serious part of how you build, with the judgement to direct, review, and stand behind what they produce. Carried product and design judgement into your engineering work, shaping the solution rather than only implementing a spec and making sensible calls under ambiguity. Owned outcomes beyond your immediate task, taking decisions rather than escalating them. At Level 5 we'll also look for Set technical direction on a hard problem other engineers built on, and been judged on whether you made them faster and safer rather than on the size of your team. Held a quality bar across other people's work without becoming the gate they wait on. Led cross-cutting or decoupling work that teams adopted because it was the best path, not because it was mandated. You’re unlikely to thrive here if You prefer following detailed instructions rather than experimenting and finding your own approach. You are uncomfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand their challenges. You avoid tackling ambiguous or open-ended problems where the solution isn’t obvious. If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us. Compensation At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally. Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make. Benefits £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development. 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total). Company pension scheme via Penfold. Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life . Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno. Private healthcare insurance through AXA. Income protection and Life Insurance. Cycle to Work Scheme. Additional perks Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.). Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights. Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry. Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together. Interview process Initial chat with our Talent team Lead Hirer Interview Live AI Skills Assessment Values Interview with the CPTO Meet the CEO Our commitment to Diversity hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive. Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure. If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team. Next steps If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome. For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page. Please note that background checks will be conducted as part of the hiring process to ensure compliance with our governance policies. We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. All applicant data will be processed in accordance with data protection regulations and our privacy policy. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Field CISO

title: Senior People Partner
description: Senior People Partner Cloudscaler | London | People Team | Reports to the Chief People Officer | £55,000–£75,000 Someone has to own the People initiative that doesn’t fit neatly into anyone’s week and the case nobody else should be handling. That someone is you — not as an escalation point, but as the person who runs the day-to-day of this function. THE MOMENT Cloudscaler is 130 people today. We’ll be 170 by the end of this year, and roughly double again in 2027. The People function is being built in real time alongside that growth, rather than inherited from someone who left years ago. You’ll be the first hire into the People team. For roughly your first year you’ll be the only People professional alongside the CPO, which means running the whole day-to-day of the function: the hardest casework and initiatives, and the operational core that keeps everything moving. A People Partner is planned to join later in 2027, and at that point the operational administration moves to them. This is also a role built with room to grow. As the team expands beyond that second hire, we expect this role to take on day-to-day operational leadership of the People Partner practice, but that isn’t the shape of it on day one. WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT In most People teams, the senior generalist is just a People Partner with a harder case queue. Here, the difference is ownership, not just difficulty. Complex casework: Rather than simply handling harder cases, you’ll own the most complex cases end to end, with no hand back. People initiatives: Rather than contributing to initiatives someone else drives, you’ll own them from design through to embedding. Decision-making: Rather than escalating ambiguity upward, you’ll make the sensible call and document your reasoning. CPO partnership: Rather than acting in a support role to the CPO, you’ll be an operational partner they can confidently delegate to. To be clear about the level: The CPO still designs the People strategy and the systems architecture. You own how it runs day to day, and you’re trusted to run a whole initiative, not just a case. That is a different job to People Partner, not a bigger version of the same one. THE ROLE You’ll sit in the People team reporting to the Chief People Officer. Three strands make up the job: Casework: The employee relations situations with the most complexity or sensitivity land with you, start to finish. Initiatives: When the CPO needs a piece of work owned (a policy rollout, a wellbeing programme, a piece of the reward or benefits agenda), you take it from design through to something that runs. Operations: Until the People Partner joins, you’ll own payroll and benefits administration, onboarding, screening and security clearances, and keeping Rippling accurate. When the People Partner joins, they’ll report to the CPO. You won’t manage them formally, but you’ll lead their handover, you’ll be the person they come to first, and your judgement will set the standard for how this function operates day to day. WHERE THE ROLE STARTS AND STOPS New roles get vague, so here is the boundary as we see it today. Yours The most complex and sensitive employee relations casework, end to end. Full ownership of People initiatives, from design to embedding. Acting as the CPO’s operational partner on ambiguous or cross-cutting problems. Until the People Partner joins (planned for later in 2027): Payroll and benefits administration, including the monthly payroll cycle in Rippling and Mintago. Pre-onboarding, onboarding and probation. Background screening in Zinc. Security clearance coordination. Rippling data quality, workflows and reporting. Our working groups and committees. Once the People Partner joins: A structured handover of the operational core. Day-to-day guidance for the People Partner. Shared Ashby, which Talent Acquisition owns. You’ll work in it from offer through to start date on every hire until the People Partner joins, and on senior hires after that. Mentoring and supporting the People Partner on their casework and initiatives, once they join. Not yours Recruitment delivery, which sits with Talent Acquisition. The design of the People strategy, the operating model and the systems architecture, which sit with the CPO. Formal line management of the People Partner, who will report to the CPO. THE STACK Rippling: Our single source of truth. Until the People Partner joins you’ll run it day to day, including the monthly payroll cycle, data quality and workflows, and you’ll use its reporting at a level that supports whole initiatives. Zinc: Background screening. You’ll run checks for every new joiner until the People Partner joins, and stay close to the senior and sensitive hires after that. Ashby: Owned by Talent Acquisition. You’ll work in it from offer through to start date on the hires you’re responsible for. Claude: A daily tool here. You’ll use it for casework preparation, drafting policy and communications, and pulling together the analysis behind an initiative. Mintago: Our employee benefits and financial wellbeing platform (pensions, salary sacrifice and financial advice). You’ll administer it and keep enrolment accurate until the People Partner takes it on. WHAT YOU’LL DO Own the hardest casework. You’ll run our most complex and sensitive employee relations cases end to end, with the CPO there to sense-check rather than take over. Own initiatives, not tasks. You’ll take a People initiative from a rough brief to something that’s running and embedded, rather than handing it back once the interesting part is done. Run the operational core. Until the People Partner joins, you’ll own the monthly payroll cycle in Rippling, benefits administration including Mintago, onboarding, background screening and security clearances. Accurate, on time, and documented as you go. Hand it over well. When the People Partner arrives, you’ll give them a working system and a clear handover, then stay the person they come to first and the judgement others in the function measure themselves against. Partner with senior leaders. You’ll be credible with leaders on the most difficult conversations: complex change, capability, and situations without a clean playbook. Use AI properly. You’ll use Claude daily to take time out of your own week, checking anything that touches a decision about a person and owning the outcome. Improve what you find. You’ll spot the gaps in policy, process or practice before anyone else does, and bring the CPO a considered view on the fix, not just the problem. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE AT 12 MONTHS You’re running the most complex ER cases with confidence, and the CPO isn’t being pulled into them. At least one or two People initiatives have gone from a rough brief to something genuinely embedded, owned by you. Payroll, benefits, onboarding and clearances run accurately and on time, and every process is documented well enough to hand over. You’ve helped shape the People Partner hire, so the handover is ready when they land. Senior leaders treat you as a credible operational partner, not an escalation point. You’ve made and documented sensible calls in genuinely ambiguous situations, and they’ve held up. The CPO can hand you an ambiguous problem and trust it gets shaped properly. WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR Deep employee relations experience. You’ve run complex disciplinaries, grievances and change situations yourself, and you know exactly when to escalate and when not to. CIPD qualification, or solid progress towards it, is welcome. A track record of owning initiatives. You can point to work you took from a brief to something that actually ran, not just a project you contributed to. Hands-on with the operational detail. You’ve owned or closely supported a payroll cycle, benefits administration and onboarding, and you’re comfortable being accountable for their accuracy while also carrying the senior work. Credible with senior leaders. You can hold your own in a difficult conversation with someone under real pressure and be listened to. Comfortable operating near-autonomously. You don’t need a playbook for everything. You make a sensible call, write it down, and check it with the CPO afterwards. Ready to grow into people leadership. You won’t formally manage anyone at the start, but you’ll induct and guide the People Partner when they join, and you should want to lead a team as the structure catches up. Discreet and organised at volume. Complex casework and live initiatives, often at the same time. You’ll need a system, and it can’t be your memory. THE HONEST PART This role sits in an odd space for now: senior in scope and judgement, without a team underneath it yet. Until the People Partner joins later in 2027, you’ll also be the whole operational team, so a payroll deadline and a complex grievance can land in the same week. That eases as the function grows, but it means the authority you carry day to day has to come from the quality of your work, not a job title. You are not designing the People strategy or the systems architecture. The CPO does that. What you get instead is real ownership of the hardest cases and the initiatives that matter, a close working relationship with the CPO, and a genuine path toward leading the People Partner practice as it grows. This probably isn’t for you if you want a formal team from day one, or if you’d rather leave payroll and onboarding to someone else. It probably is for you if you want to prove you can run this function well enough, top to bottom, that a team gets built around you. If that sounds like the challenge you’ve been looking for, let’s talk. title: Strategic Client Manager
description: About Flock Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time. We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead. We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us! About the role Our largest fleet clients have the most vehicles, the most data and the most to gain from our connected proposition. As our Strategic Client Manager, you’ll be the main face of Flock for them, from multinationals and well-known brands to fast-growing sector leaders, and you’ll own those relationships end to end. Nearly all our business comes through brokers, so you’ll sit at the centre of the client, broker and Flock relationship, working closely with our Broker Development Managers and teams across the business. You’ll build our corporate client management approach from scratch, from account reviews and performance reporting to bringing claims, safety, underwriting and finance together for our biggest clients. You’ll report to our Head of Distribution and use AI day to day to prepare for meetings, understand accounts and improve reporting. Success means our clients stay with us and recommend us to others. What you’ll be doing Own the relationship with a portfolio of Flock’s largest fleet clients, becoming their primary point of contact and developing a strong understanding of their business. Build and run our corporate account management approach: client reviews, reporting, relationship cadence and account planning. Work closely with brokers and our Broker Development Managers to deliver a coordinated experience for every large corporate client. Bring together teams across Flock, including claims, safety, underwriting and finance, to resolve client questions and issues quickly, and build strong relationships with key stakeholders across client organisations. Identify retention risks early and create clear plans to protect our most important accounts. Help shape and improve Flock’s wider client service proposition, including account reviews, portal engagement, safety support, claims and reporting, feeding client feedback back into the business. Use AI in your day-to-day work, from account research and meeting preparation to query management, meeting summaries and client reporting. What you’ll need Strong experience within the insurance industry, with a clear understanding of the broker–client–insurer dynamic and the judgement to know where you add value, without duplicating the broker’s role, creating confusion or adding unnecessary layers for the client. Experience in a client-facing role such as insurer account or deal management, broker account management, claims relationship management or a similar position. A proven track record of managing important client relationships and delivering strong retention or customer satisfaction, with the confidence to work with senior stakeholders across clients, brokers and internal teams. Strong commercial judgement. You can identify when an account is at risk, understand what matters to the client and build a plan to retain them. Energy and ownership. You’re comfortable picking up a problem, finding the right people and driving it through to a solution. Confident using technology in your daily work, curious about how it can help you work faster and deliver a better client experience. Nice to have: experience with large, complex or multi-site corporate clients, Commercial Motor Fleet or fleet risk and safety experience, or exposure to claims or to building a client service proposition. Benefits 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖 Share Incentive Plan 📈 Workplace Pension 💰 Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options) Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵 Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣 £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓 £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻 We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. This role is expected to be field based rather than office based, so visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days. Making the world quantifiably safer takes more than good data. It takes a team where different perspectives are heard, and that’s a priority here. We insure fleets and drivers from every background, and we know a team built the same way makes sharper decisions and a better product for our customers. So we hire on merit, full stop, and we actively encourage applications from everyone. If you don’t tick every box, apply anyway. Just come as your genuine self: the qualities and experiences only you bring are exactly what we want. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">About THG</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":160,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Our portfolio of</span><span data-contrast="auto"> leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG. </span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for?</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":279}"> </span></p></div><p><strong>About THG</strong></p> <p>We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition.</p> <p>Our leading retailers and brands, including LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD and Cult Beauty, make up our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition.</p> <p>From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG.</p> <p>With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for?</p> <p><strong>Location: Icon 1, WA15 0AF </strong></p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Technical Programme Manager to lead the delivery of our most important customer-facing technology programmes, reporting directly to the <strong>Chief Technology Officer</strong>.</p> <p>THG runs several high-profile ecommerce websites in nutrition and beauty, including myprotein.com and lookfantastic.com. Our websites and mobile apps are how customers find, buy and come back to our brands, and the programmes you lead will shape that experience directly.</p> <p>You will own programmes from first idea to launch, mainly across our websites and mobile apps. Examples include personalisation, loyalty and digital marketing technology, and some programmes will reach into other parts of the technology estate. The role is an even mix of programme and project management. You will run long-lived programmes that span many teams, and drive individual projects hands-on when they need it. You will work with executives to decide what gets built and in what order, and tell them plainly how delivery is going.</p> <p>You don’t need to be the architect. Our technology leaders set the technical direction and you will follow their lead. You do need to understand how large websites and apps are built well enough to plan the work, spot risks early and ask the right questions.</p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>As a Technical Programme Manager you will:</strong></p> <p><strong>Programme Delivery</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>End-to-End Ownership:</strong> Own the delivery of large technology programmes across our websites and mobile apps, from scoping and planning through to launch and review.</li> <li><strong>Programme Planning:</strong> Build and maintain programme plans, milestones and dependency maps across several engineering and product teams.</li> <li><strong>Hands-On Project Delivery:</strong> Run individual projects directly when a programme needs it.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Prioritisation & Product Partnership</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Executive Prioritisation:</strong> Bring options, costs and trade-offs to executives and secure a clear decision on what comes first.</li> <li><strong>Backlog Management:</strong> Manage the backlog for your programmes so engineering teams always know what is next and why.</li> <li><strong>Product Collaboration:</strong> Work with product managers to turn business goals into well-defined, deliverable pieces of work.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Reporting, Risk & Vendors</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Honest Reporting:</strong> Give executives and stakeholders clear, candid updates on progress, risks and dates.</li> <li><strong>Risk & Dependency Management:</strong> Find risks, blockers and cross-team dependencies early, resolve them, and escalate when a decision is needed.</li> <li><strong>Vendor Management:</strong> Hold external vendors and delivery partners to their commitments and fit their work into our plans and releases.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Continuous Improvement</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Ways of Working:</strong> Improve how we plan, track and report on delivery across the technology organisation.</li> </ul> <p><strong>A day in the life</strong></p> <p>Your day is split between the teams doing the work and the leaders deciding what the work should be. You might start with an engineering team, checking progress against the plan and clearing a blocker, then spend time with a product manager breaking a loyalty feature into deliverable stages. In the afternoon you could review a vendor’s delivery plan for a marketing technology integration, then update programme status ahead of an executive review, where you’ll set out where things stand, what is at risk and which decisions you need. You’ll leave with clear priorities and take them back to the teams.</p> <p><strong>What skills and experience do I need for this role?</strong></p> <p><strong>Essential Requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>Highly Skilled in technical programme or project management.</li> <li>Experience working directly with software engineering teams.</li> <li>Adept at delivering customer-facing websites or mobile apps.</li> <li>Excellent at managing programmes across several teams, including planning, dependency management and release coordination.</li> <li>Experience running prioritisation and backlog management with senior stakeholders and reporting on delivery to executives.</li> <li>Managing both external vendors or delivery partners.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable Attributes</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with websites and ecommerce at large scale: high traffic, many markets, or several brands.</li> <li>Experience delivering programmes in personalisation, loyalty or digital marketing technology.</li> <li>Experience delivering native mobile apps alongside web.</li> <li>Experience in retail, particularly nutrition or beauty.</li> <li>A record of bringing clear structure to ambiguous, multi-team programmes.</li> <li>Strong written communication, with the ability to explain a complex programme to executives in plain terms.</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>THG is proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you are invited to interview, please let us know if there are any reasonable adjustments we can make to the recruitment process that will enable you to perform to the best of your ability.</strong></p> <p><strong>THG is committed to creating a diverse & inclusive environment and hence welcomes applications from all sections of the community.</strong></p> <p><strong>Because of the high volumes of applications our opportunities attract, it sometimes takes us time to review and consider them all. We endeavour to respond to every application we receive within 14 days. If you haven't heard from us within that time frame or should you have any specific questions about this or other applications for positions at THG please contact one of our <span class="mark75xs2u5gf" data-markjs="true" data-ogac="" data-ogab="" data-ogsc="" data-ogsb="">Talent</span> team to discuss further.</strong></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Head of Legal
description: Head of Legal 📍Manchester | 💰 £120,000 - £150,000 Street Group is a fast moving B2B SaaS business - grown in Manchester but on a UK wide mission to make moving house as easy as buying a car. We’ve recently raised strategic growth investment, and are scaling fast toward an ambitious growth plan. To support this growth, we're moving from fractional legal support to our first full-time in-house lawyer. As we grow and our product and client base expand, we need someone who can own the legal function day to day. As this is our first full-time legal hire, we're looking for a self-starter who is passionate about the role and who will build, own and manage our internal legal function, creating value and protecting the business from risk. You’ll work autonomously and efficiently, leading on legal matters and bringing in external counsel where required, and you’ll report directly to our CFO. How you'll make a difference Take ownership of the legal function, including a smooth handover from the current fractional counsel. Lead on B2B SaaS contracting: draft, negotiate and manage customer, partner and supplier agreements, and maintain contract templates and playbooks. Update terms and conditions as new product features are released, working closely with product, sales and commercial colleagues. Act as product counsel on AI-enabled features: advise product and engineering on the legal and regulatory implications of AI in Street Group’s products (including data use and training, IP and output ownership, accuracy and liability, and transparency), and ensure customer terms, data terms and product documentation reflect them. Advise on data protection, privacy and information security, including customer-facing data terms and requirements. Work with compliance and governance colleagues to establish and maintain corporate governance, AI governance and policy, and compliance frameworks. Identify and adopt AI tools and legal technology within the function to improve speed, consistency and capacity. Manage relationships with external law firms, including specialist advisers retained for equity and other matters, to ensure cost-effective use of external spend. Support M&A and other strategic transactions, including legal due diligence and post-acquisition integration. Identify and manage legal risks ahead of any future diligence or exit process. Advise the executive team and, as required, the Board on legal, regulatory and risk matters. Keep up to date with legislative and regulatory change affecting the business. Who we're looking for You’re qualified to practise in England and Wales, with 8+ years’ PQE gained in a law firm, in-house, or both. You have strong experience drafting and negotiating B2B SaaS agreements, ideally with institutional or regulated customers. You’re commercially focused: you act as a partner to sales, product and senior leadership and balance legal risk with commercial objectives. You have a sound understanding of data protection law and practical exposure to information security and technology risk. You have up-to-date knowledge of AI regulation and market practice as it affects SaaS products, with experience of advising on, or contracting around, AI features and of how customers and regulators are approaching them. You take a forward-thinking approach to AI and legal technology, with a track record of applying it to legal work. You’ve built or scaled a legal function, including templates, processes and external counsel management. You’re able to work autonomously as the sole in-house lawyer, with the judgement to know when to escalate or bring in specialists. You have excellent negotiation, communication and problem-solving skills, and you turn complex legal issues into practical, business-oriented advice. You manage multiple workstreams in a fast-paced environment. Bonus points if… You’ve worked in an FCA-regulated business. You’ve worked in a private equity-backed business. You have M&A experience, including due diligence and post-deal integration. You’ve had exposure to governance, company secretarial and ESG matters. Why Join Us? A role with genuine commercial impact - you won’t be a support function here Direct access to the Co-Founders and leadership team Hybrid working from our Manchester office, with the option to WFH 3 days a week. Guilt-Free R&R - £1000 towards a holiday after your first year with the team (we'll even cover the tax!) Joining a culture that supports your development and encourages growth £500 yearly L&D budget for your career development Your birthday on us - we pay, you stay away ‘Give something back’ - 2 paid days volunteering on us Enhanced maternity, paternity & adoption pay Mental health & well-being support via Health Assured Regular well-being initiatives Flexible working hours Public transport season ticket loans Paid menopause leave Holiday buying scheme Be a part of something bigger - everyone in our team is passionate about improving the entire property industry! It's a huge goal, but it motivates us to do better every single day A chance to work on cutting-edge technology Comfortable, relaxed office space - office dogs welcome! Research has shown that women tend to rule themselves out of applying for jobs unless they meet 100% of the requirements. If you fall into that category and were about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria; please consider applying anyway. We'd love to see your application! Salary £120k - £150k dependent on experience. However, sometimes the perfect person is far more or less experienced than we anticipated. In these situations, planned ranges go out the window. If you think that might be the case, please apply and just let us know. We care deeply about helping the tech industry become a more inclusive and diverse place and we work hard to lead by example. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a complementary team of employees and building an inclusive environment for all. Candidates must be eligible to live and work in the UK and be able to perform the work specified. Interview Process 3 stages = Video call with our Head of People > Technical Interview > Values interview. We want to make our interviews as inclusive as possible, so if you need any adjustments made, or if there's anything you think we should be aware of during the interview process, please do let us know. A note on using AI in your job application As a fast-moving and rapidly evolving tech company, we embrace the advantages of AI and encourage its use throughout our application process. However, our goal is to get to know and hire the authentic you - your skills, experience, and values. We don’t want to hire an AI-generated version of you. We consider AI to be a valuable tool, not something that should overshadow you as an individual. How we use AI in the hiring process Candidate experience is really important to us, and our Talent team use AI notetakers during interviews so they can focus purely on their conversation with you. All hiring decisions are made by humans - not AI. Let us know if you have any questions! Compensation: £120K – £150K • £120K – £150K Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Security Operations Analyst
description: About Lendable Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start: One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK Profitable since 2017 Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot ) So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance . We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days. We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes. Join us if you want to Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1 Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions Build the best technology in-house : we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting About the Role Lendable is a high-growth FinTech building its security operations capability deliberately. As a Senior Security Operations Analyst, you will triage and respond to security alerts, help improve the quality of the detections behind them, and lead the response when a security event becomes an incident. You will investigate alerts and escalations from our MSSP, tune our monitoring so that it finds more of what matters and less of what doesn’t, and act as a trusted Incident Commander for security incidents, from declaration through to post-incident review. You will work with Engineering, IT, Legal, Risk and senior stakeholders, and you will be credible with all of them. AI is used widely across the business, in how we build software, run operations and serve customers, and that changes both what security incidents look like and how quickly we can respond to them. You will use AI and automation as a normal part of your work, and you will be able to investigate and respond to incidents where AI tooling is the cause, the target or the route in. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone with hands-on SOC experience and a track record of commanding incidents. What You’ll Be Doing 1. Alert Triage & Monitoring Triage and investigate alerts across our SIEM, EDR, identity and cloud tooling, taking escalations from our MSSP’s first-line team. Reduce false positives and alert fatigue by tuning detection rules, thresholds and suppressions. Utilise AI and automation to speed up triage, enrichment and response, and to remove repetitive manual work from the analyst workflow. 2. Incident Command & Response Command security incidents, coordinating technical response, decision-making and communications across Engineering, IT, Legal, Risk and senior stakeholders. Give clear, timely updates to executives during live incidents. Lead or support technical investigation and containment across endpoint, identity and cloud (AWS/GCP) environments, including incidents involving AI use, such as prompt injection, or credentials exposed through AI-generated code. Run blameless post-incident reviews, track actions to closure, and feed lessons back into detection, playbooks and controls. Take part in the out-of-hours on-call rota. 3. Operational Reporting & Assurance Track and report SecOps metrics that reflect reality, such as alert quality, time to triage, time to contain, incident volumes and root causes. Maintain accurate incident records and evidence in our incident management platform to support audit and assurance activity. Build working relationships with Engineering, Platform and IT Systems so that incident response is practised before it is needed. What We’re Looking For Proven incident command: Demonstrable experience leading significant security incidents as Incident Commander or lead responder, from declaration to resolution and review. You can describe incidents you have run, the decisions you made and what you changed afterwards. Technical investigation skills: Solid hands-on SOC/DFIR experience, including log analysis, endpoint and identity investigation, and cloud incident response in AWS or GCP. title: Chief Growth Officer
description: About Numan Founded in 2018, we’ve already grown to be a 300+ team distributed across the globe, united by a singular mission: empowering people to take control of their health. Numan is transforming health: we’ve built a cutting-edge platform that integrates diagnostics, medication, supplements, digital programmes, and doctor consultations. Giving people the tools they need to maximise life. To deliver on our transformative mission, we are guided by our 5 company values: • Patients first. • Learn fast. • Own the quality. • Succeed together. • Care deeply. Backed by top-tier investors, Numan is already having a positive impact on hundreds of thousands of patients here in the UK, and we want you to help us deliver this mission! The Role: This is a new role at Numan. It marks a significant intent in how we want to operate and invest in areas that make a meaningful impact to business performance. This role will report directly to our Founder & CEO and serve as a trusted advisor and partner to our Board, Executive team, and cross-functional leaders across Product, Commercial, and Growth Marketing. As an established D2C Growth leader, you will be a big influencer on our growth culture more broadly. You'll be: Leading the company’s growth mission, acting as a trusted board advisor to investors and board members, clearly articulating Numan’s growth strategy, cohort dynamics, strategic bets, and capital allocation. Coaching and developing growth marketing leadership teams while raising execution pace, energy, and commercial ambition across the entire business. Formulating growth hypotheses and balancing macro market shifts with unit economics like CAC, LTV, and payback periods to validate and de-risk high-stakes investments. Rapidly diagnosing growth bottlenecks and building high-velocity multi-channel engines, focused on compounding growth. Serving as a culture beacon across the organisation to inspire and align teams that directly or indirectly impact revenue opportunities and growth levers. Monitoring full-funnel performance metrics daily to extract maximum leverage from lean budgets, scaling winning channels rapidly and pivoting decisively before returns diminish. Pioneering data and AI-driven growth across creative production, rapid experimentation, and advanced measurement. You'll have: Significant experience in building consumer businesses, either as a founder, operator holding roles directly responsible for growth. Proven track record scaling consumer businesses through major revenue step-changes (£10–100m, or £100m–250m+) navigating high-growth environments. Significant exposure to building toward substantial enterprise value creation in a growth or GTM role. Hands-on experience building new channels from scratch and navigating real operational battles, strategic pivots, and market headwinds. Experience shaping company growth strategy at the board level alongside founders and executive teams. A formidable combination of deep data analytics, performance marketing, and cutting-edge tools, balancing a strategic macro view with an extreme focus on execution. You have a strong bias for action and not just theory. Total comfort navigating ambiguity and shifting markets, with a practical, analytical approach to making decisions and managing lean resources. Our benefits include... 📈 - Share options. 🏖 - 25 days holiday, plus bank holidays (increasing to 30 the longer you stay with Numan). 🩺 - Health insurance with Vitality . 🚘 - Electric car salary sacrifice scheme with Octopus . 🧸 - Enhanced maternity and parental leave. 🥳 - A day off on your Birthday! 🐥 - Nursery benefit provided by YellowNest . 💼 - Employee assistance programme (access to therapy, financial planning and discounts). ⚖️ - Generous pension (includes both employee and employer contributions). 💻 - Flexible working options, including a dog-friendly office in Farringdon. 📚 - Personal training and development budget via Learnerbly. 👟 - Wellhub membership, giving you access to over 2,000 locations in the UK. 🚲 - Cycle to work scheme. 🚆 - Season ticket loan. % - Discount on Numan products for your friends and family. 🤲 - Paid volunteering days. 📅 - An additional 2 weeks off once you reach your 5th anniversary with Numan. Diversity at Numan At Numan, people are at the heart of who we are. We recognise and value the unique perspectives and experiences that individuals from all backgrounds bring. We promote innovation and creativity, enabling us to tackle things from various viewpoints and are committed to equal opportunities and continuously strive to create a workplace where everyone feels respected, heard, and valued. Embracing diversity isn't just our goal; it's our strength, driving us towards a more inclusive future. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Product Designer
description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <div class="gmail_quote"> <div> <div><span id="m_-113912706363268805m_-2746164444908759431gmail-docs-internal-guid-131e4fb0-7fff-b4e9-ff50-e8cf32449b1b">CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at <a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div> </div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p> </p></div><p><strong>About Physical AI</strong></p> <p>CoreWeave's Physical AI team helps companies apply AI to the physical systems they design, test, and operate, across automotive, industrial, robotics, and autonomous vehicles (AV).</p> <p>We work as one cross-functional team of product, design, engineering, and forward-deployed engineers, partnering directly with our customers' engineering teams.</p> <p>Our focus is twofold: making AI usable for engineers who know their machines in depth but are not ML specialists, and supporting robotics and AV teams across the full development loop, from sensor data and simulation to model training and evaluation.</p> <h3><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong></h3> <p>As a <strong>Staff Product Designer</strong> on the Physical AI team, you will lead design across our portfolio of Physical AI products, turning complex data and ML workflows into tools that engineers who build vehicles, machines, and robots trust and use every day. You'll bring strong design craft and sharp product judgment to a new product area, setting direction and framing ambiguous problems.</p> <p>This is a role with real breadth. You'll own the end-to-end experience across a number of products, from the customer-facing apps engineers use day to day to the builder tools our Field team use to create and publish those apps. You'll set a shared design vision for the portfolio and consolidate our Physical AI products into the broader CoreWeave design language, so they reuse proven patterns and feel like part of one platform. You'll also spend time with customer engineering teams to understand their workflows, data, and constraints, turning what you learn into clear problem framing for Product and Engineering.</p> <p>We're looking for a designer who uses AI tools as a core part of their workflow today, to prototype, test ideas, and explore more options in less time. Comfort with technical complexity and a bias toward experimentation are essential here.</p> <p>As the most senior designer on the Physical AI team, you'll mentor the designers you work alongside, raise the craft bar, and shape how design works with Product, Engineering, and Field Engineering. You'll be joining a small, high-trust design team. The work is broad, the impact is real, and there's room to shape how design operates at one of the fastest-growing infrastructure companies in the world.</p> <p><strong>Who You Are:</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience as a versatile designer who can own all facets of design, including user research, UX, interaction design, prototyping, and UI design.</li> <li>An excellent portfolio showcasing user-centered problem solving through interaction design, visual design, and systems thinking.</li> <li>Deep proficiency with Figma and a solid understanding of building usable, accessible, and modular designs that scale.</li> <li>Experience partnering with Product and Engineering to define strategy and solve complex problems for technical users in B2B, infrastructure, developer tools, or platform contexts.</li> <li>Actively incorporates AI tools into your design workflow, using them to move faster, prototype smarter, and tackle harder problems.</li> <li>Comfortable working with technical complexity and ambiguity; you help teams frame problems, not just resolve them.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, or modern frameworks for prototyping or implementation.</li> <li>Familiarity with ML concepts such as training, evaluation, and deployment, or with simulation and test workflows.</li> <li>Familiarity with cloud infrastructure or enterprise platform products.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wondering if you’re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk. </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Care deeply about users:</strong> You love connecting with real users daily, helping them solve issues and understand good patterns for using our tools. You approach questions and requests with a kind, thoughtful tone that makes users feel appreciated and connected to our team.</li> <li><strong>Autonomous:</strong> You work well in a self-directed environment, proactively finding ways to improve processes and collaborate with team members or engaged users.</li> <li><strong>Curious and driven:</strong> You are eager to explore machine learning and learn more about the engineering stack and common ML workflows, solving problems in both fast-paced, short-term sprints and in larger, long-term projects.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Why Us?</strong></h3> <p>We work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Be Curious at Your Core</strong></li> <li><strong>Act Like an Owner</strong></li> <li><strong>Empower Employees</strong></li> <li><strong>Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences</strong></li> <li><strong>Achieve More Together</strong></li> </ul> <p>We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and provides the opportunity to develop innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.</em></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:</p> <ul> <li>Family-level Medical Insurance</li> <li>Family-level Dental Insurance </li> <li>Generous Pension Contribution </li> <li>Life Assurance at 4x Salary </li> <li>Critical Illness Cover </li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme </li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement</li> <li>Work culture focused on innovative disruption</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits may vary by location. </em></p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity </strong></p> <p><em>CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.</em></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Recruitment Agencies</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em><em data-stringify-type="italic">CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. Any unsolicited CVs received will be treated as the property of CoreWeave and your Terms & Conditions associated with the use of CVs will be considered null and void.</em></em></span></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em data-stringify-type="italic">Any unsolicited CVs sent by your company to us – that is to say, in any situation where we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy – will be considered by us to be a “free gift”, leaving us liable for no fees whatsoever should we choose to contact the candidate directly and engage the candidate’s services, and will in no way establish any prior claim by your company to representation of that candidate should the candidate’s details also be submitted by any other party.</em></span></em></p> <p><strong>Export Control Compliance</strong></p> <p><em>This position requires access to technology and/or source code subject to U.S. export control laws. title: Senior Applied Researcher
description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <div class="gmail_quote"> <div> <div><span id="m_-113912706363268805m_-2746164444908759431gmail-docs-internal-guid-131e4fb0-7fff-b4e9-ff50-e8cf32449b1b">CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at <a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div> </div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p> </p></div><p><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong></p> <p>CoreWeave’s Monolith team is building the essential cloud platform for AI innovators, applying machine learning to solve intractable physics and engineering challenges. We operate at the intersection of advanced cloud infrastructure and applied data science, transforming how complex industrial products - such as automotive systems, aircraft, and advanced batteries - are conceived, tested, and developed.</p> <p><strong>About the role:</strong></p> <p>As a Senior Applied Researcher, you will take end-to-end ownership of complex machine learning problems across the Physical AI space. This is a high-impact role for someone with a strong technical foundation and a generalist mindset who can move from problem framing and experimentation through deployment and ongoing support.</p> <p>You will work closely with engineering, product, and client-facing teams to turn advanced ML methods into production-ready solutions that can be trusted in real customer environments. The role blends research depth with practical delivery, and requires someone who can align stakeholders, surface risks and limitations, and communicate technical decisions clearly.</p> <p><strong>Who You Are:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, or applied AI, with evidence of delivering high-impact production ML systems.</li> <li>Strong software engineering skills in Python, with extensive experience using scientific computing and ML libraries such as NumPy, pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.</li> <li>Experience deploying and supporting ML systems in production, including cloud-based environments.</li> <li>Strong grounding in statistical modelling, machine learning experimentation, and evaluation.</li> <li>Experience working with time-series, high-dimensional, or imperfect real-world datasets.</li> <li>Strong technical curiosity and a habit of keeping up with current ML and AI research.</li> <li>Comfortable working cross-functionally with engineering, product, and customer-facing teams, and able to explain technical decisions clearly to different audiences.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred: (if applicable)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Background in engineering, physics, chemistry, or another STEM discipline connected to complex physical systems.</li> <li>Experience with anomaly detection, optimisation, reliability-focused modelling, or related approaches in industrial settings.</li> <li>Experience building or experimenting with agents or autonomous systems.</li> <li>Familiarity with MLOps, model monitoring, and efficient compute practices.</li> <li>Experience working with sparse, noisy, or imperfect real-world data from labs, heavy industry, or other applied environments.</li> <li>Track record of collaborating closely with deployed or client-facing teams to bring advanced methods into operational use.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wondering if you’re a good fit? </strong><strong>We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match.</strong><strong> Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk. </strong></p> <ul> <li>You love applying advanced ML to real-world, high-value physical engineering problems.</li> <li>You're curious about agentic and autonomous approaches and how they can reshape engineering workflows.</li> <li>You're an expert in taking ML solutions from research and modelling through production delivery, with a strong bias toward reusable, high-quality systems.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why CoreWeave?</strong></p> <p>At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast!  We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values: </p> <ul> <li>Be Curious at Your Core</li> <li>Act Like an Owner</li> <li>Empower Employees</li> <li>Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences</li> <li>Achieve More Together</li> </ul> <p>We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organization's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!  </p> <p>The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.</em></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:</p> <ul> <li>Family-level Medical Insurance</li> <li>Family-level Dental Insurance </li> <li>Generous Pension Contribution </li> <li>Life Assurance at 4x Salary </li> <li>Critical Illness Cover </li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme </li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement</li> <li>Work culture focused on innovative disruption</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits may vary by location. </em></p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity </strong></p> <p><em>CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. title: Senior Staff Accountant
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3 id="isPasted"><strong>Company Overview</strong></h3> <p>Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.</p> <p>Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.</p> <p>At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game.
