title: Senior Manager, Performance Creative Strategy – Casino (Remote)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 class="job-details__description-header text-color-secondary font-family-secondary" data-bind="i18n: 'job-details.employer-description-title'">About Us</h2> <div class="job-details__description-content basic-formatter" data-bind="html: pageData().job.corporateDescription"> <p>Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. This includes licensed fan gear and lifestyle products, sportsbook and iGaming, physical and digital trading cards, live events, premium sports entertainment content, credit card offerings and more. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem — connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport — delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players’ associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience.</p> </div> <p> </p></div><p><strong>Primary Focus:</strong></p> <p>As Senior Manager, Performance Creative Strategy at Fanatics Betting & Gaming (FBG), you are responsible for defining the strategic priorities, audience opportunities and learning agenda that shape Fanatics Casino performance creative. You’ll uncover the hooks, angles and player insights most likely to resonate, translate them into clear, inspiring briefs for the internal creative team, and track performance to understand what works and why. This role is the strategic link between player insight, creative development and performance results, ensuring the right problems are being solved and that learnings continuously inform future briefs across acquisition, engagement and retention.</p> <p>This position reports directly to the Senior Director, Performance Creative & GTM, and manages one Associate, Performance Creative.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the Casino performance creative strategy across paid social, app networks, CTV, affiliates and lifecycle, aligned with business priorities, audience insight and brand positioning.</li> <li>Build and evolve the Casino creative variation framework, mapping hooks, angles, reasons to believe, formats and offers to audience and funnel stage.</li> <li>Translate business objectives and player insight into clear, inspiring briefs for the internal creative agency, including scripts, hook variations and iteration briefs on winning concepts.</li> <li>Own the Casino testing agenda, defining what we want to learn, how we measure a win, and which tests run each month.</li> <li>Drive a high-velocity testing program across hooks, openers, formats, offers and creators, continuously improving hit rate and speed to learning.</li> <li>Partner with Media and Analytics to track creative performance, identify winners and fatigue early, and apply learnings to the next round of briefs.</li> <li>Write concise test readouts and maintain a living library of what works for Casino players.</li> <li>Identify and define the performance territories, audience tensions and messaging opportunities to support creative briefs</li> <li>Embed performance requirements into brand and full-funnel campaign briefs from the outset (in collaboration with integrated marketing and media), ensuring channel, audience, format and measurement needs are clear before creative development begins. Partner with the Casino Creative Studio to translate those requirements into effective creative, with the Studio retaining ownership of creative direction and execution.</li> <li>Advise Brand and agency partners on hooks, edits, cutdowns, aspect ratios and platform-native versions, so big campaign moments carry through to always-on performance and lifecycle.</li> <li>Source player insight, competitor ad libraries, creator content and platform trends to identify new angles and white space.</li> <li>Lead performance strategy/creative insight sessions and contribute a strong POV to creative brainstorms, working closely with the Casino Creative Studio.</li> <li>Present performance learnings and recommendations in GTM forums and monthly reviews, turning results into a clear story for senior leadership.</li> <li>Lead, mentor and develop an Associate, building their craft in briefing, analysis and testing.</li> </ul> <p><strong>How This Role Connects Across the Team:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partners with the internal producer, who owns production timelines and delivery, to keep briefs, priorities and the content calendar aligned.</li> <li>Partners with the Casino Creative Studio and Integrated Marketing to shape high-quality output, providing direction and feedback while respecting executional ownership.</li> <li>Partners with Brand and Integrated Marketing to embed performance best practice into campaigns, ensuring work is both distinctive and built to perform across the funnel.</li> <li>Partners with Media, Analytics and CRM to define success measures, read results and feed learnings back into strategy.</li> <li>Works with Legal, Compliance and Creative Operations to keep all creative compliant and aligned with Responsible Gaming standards.</li> <li>Partner with the affiliates teams to produce UGC briefs aligned to channel best practice, adapting content that’s optimised for performance (via creative briefs)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills & Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience in creative strategy, performance creative or brand strategy, including 3+ years leading creative strategy for a fast-growing D2C brand, mobile app, gaming or casino business.</li> <li>Portfolio demonstrating hook-led, insight-driven creative and the performance results behind it.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of platform-native creative across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Snap and app networks, including UGC and creator formats.</li> <li>Proven track record building and running creative testing programs at volume.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills, with the ability to read performance data, size results and translate them into clear recommendations.</li> <li>Excellent storytelling and writing skills, from a 6-second hook to a campaign narrative to an executive readout.</li> <li>Experience influencing brand and integrated campaigns across matrixed teams without direct ownership.</li> <li>Experience managing and developing direct reports.</li> <li>Willingness to travel occasionally for team meetings and Fanatics events.</li> </ul> <p>Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi-day cultural immersion in New York City for full-time, non-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process.</p> <p>For information about our benefits, please visit <a href="https://benefitsatfanatics.com/">https://benefitsatfanatics.com/</a></p> <p>#li-JM3</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p>By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our <a href="https://static1.squarespace.com/static/5ff494b9931735466ce28d5b/t/69de53bde2c02c25e9c38758/1776178110037/Candidate+Privacy+Policy+April+2026.pdf" target="_blank">Candidate Privacy Policy.</a></p> <p><em>Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it </em><a ----- <p></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

For information about our benefits, please visit <a href="https://benefitsatfanatics.com/">https://benefitsatfanatics.com/</a></p> <p> </p> <p> </p></div><div class="title">Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£40,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>£50,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p>By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our <a href="https://static1.squarespace.com/static/5ff494b9931735466ce28d5b/t/69de53bde2c02c25e9c38758/1776178110037/Candidate+Privacy+Policy+April+2026.pdf" target="_blank">Candidate Privacy Policy.</a></p> <p><em>Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. title: Client Complaint Senior Analyst
description: Trust unlocks our greatest potential. For decades, the clearing of payments remained unchanged and unchallenged. We asked, what if there was a better way? What if we could make banking infrastructure faster, safer, more reliable, and easier to access for all? Here is where you can think radically and responsibly to find the best solution. What happens when you know you’re inherently trusted? Trust creates safety. Safety encourages you to be brave, to challenge, to fail, to try new things and to execute. At ClearBank everything revolves around trust. We’re not expected to earn it, but we are expected not to break it. We’re trusted to own it. To solve issues in the moment. To know a good risk when we see one, and the judgement to know that ‘can’ doesn’t always mean you ‘should’ What you can expect: ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank. If that excites you, how about joining our Client Services team as a Client Complaint Senior Analyst? Reporting to the Associate Director, Client Support you will take independent ownership of client complaints, using your judgement and complaints expertise to resolve non-routine cases fairly, effectively and within relevant requirements. You will support consistently high standards across complaint handling by identifying themes and improvements, sharing your knowledge and providing direct line management, day-to-day support and coaching to the Complaint Analyst. Your role includes: Independently manage client complaints from receipt through to resolution, applying sound judgement to deliver fair, timely and well-evidenced outcomes in line with complaint handling standards, relevant requirements and internal policies Investigate non-routine complaints, bringing together information from systems, teams and stakeholders to establish root cause, reach appropriate conclusions and identify when complex matters require escalation Produce clear, accurate and customer-focused written responses, ensuring decisions and outcomes are appropriately supported and communicated Identify recurring complaint themes, risks and root causes, using insight from cases to suggest practical improvements to customer outcomes, service quality and complaint management processes Take direct line management responsibility for the Client Complaint Analyst, setting clear objectives, holding regular one-to-ones, providing feedback and coaching, and supporting their onboarding, performance and development Share complaints knowledge and best practice across the team while continuing to manage your own complaint caseload Support consistent complaint handling standards across the team by providing guidance on day-to-day cases and constructively challenging where an approach may not achieve the right outcome Build trusted relationships across Client Services, Financial Crime, Operations, Product and other relevant teams to resolve issues and support improvements that benefit customers and the Bank What you’ll bring: To excel in this role, you’ll also need: Strong working knowledge of complaint handling in a customer service, financial services, operations or regulated environment, with the ability to apply relevant processes, policies and controls independently Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, including the ability to investigate non-routine issues, assess evidence, identify root causes and reach well-reasoned conclusions Sound judgement, with the confidence to make day-to-day decisions independently and recognise when a more complex or higher-risk matter should be escalated Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex matters clearly and produce high-quality customer communications Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage varied complaint activity and competing priorities while maintaining quality and timeliness A collaborative approach, with the ability to line manage the Complaints Analysts, set clear expectations, provide constructive feedback and coaching, and support their performance and development Curiosity and a continuous-improvement mindset, with the confidence to identify problems, challenge constructively and suggest better ways of working What makes a great ClearBank team member? Does this sound like you? You focus on solutions and positive outcomes, thinking radically and responsibly to find the best result for our customers, your colleagues and the bank; You actively seek feedback from others to drive your growth and development, always assuming positive intent from others and develop strong, trusting relationships you’re your colleagues and customers: you really, genuinely care; You always strive for the highest quality, but you know that done is better than perfect; you welcome a challenge knowing that they learn as you go and iterate; ‘I’ before ’we’, isn’t in your vocabulary. Regretfully we are not able to sponsor applicants for immigration purposes at the current time. What we offer in return: We're flexible – We support a culture of flexibility which allows our employees to achieve a strong work-life balance. Offices – Work in a way that works for you – whether that’s in the London office, at home, or hybrid. Holiday – 27 days of annual leave per year, plus bank holidays. Holiday buy/sell - Buy or sell up to five days of annual leave each year and shape your year around what matters most. Work abroad – You have the flexibility to work outside of the UK for up to 30 days in a rolling 12-month period. Socials – Regular social events open to all. Holiday swap – Option to swap your bank holidays to any other day of your choice. Wellbeing – 24/7 employee assistance programme including mental health support, life assurance and income protection. Bigger than ClearBank – Take a couple of days per year to do something that matters to you. Healthy living – Private healthcare and discounted dental cover, with employee perks and discounts. Family – Enhanced family-friendly leave. Personal development – We offer personal development budgets, opportunities to take part in role-related training and unlimited LinkedIn Learning. And not forgetting the biggest benefit of all. The opportunity to be part of an incredible team that’s building a tech-bank fit for the future. A little bit more about us! ClearBank is Where You Can belong: At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 42% of our senior management roles are held by women Our enhanced family leave policies Launching our partnership with Code First Girls Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group Our hiring process and what you can expect: Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). You can expect to hear back from us within seven days following this meeting (if things are taking longer than expected, we’ll let you know that too); First Interview: You’ll spend one hour with a member of our hiring team focusing on your skills, competencies and your ways of working at the same time we’ll give you time to ask more questions about the role, the team and learn more about the ClearBank culture. This will be via Teams. Second Interview: This will be a competency-based interview with one or more members of our team. Final Stage: You will have a final meeting with the Head of Department. This will be around 45-60 minutes. Offer: Congratulations! Get ready to transform banking forever! Our commitment to you as a candidate: We will always try our best to get back to you within seven days of your interview whether you’ve been successful or not and provide you with feedback. Sometimes things take a little longer, so we may not have a decision to share but we will get it touch to let you know we need a little more time. We’re unable to provide specific individual feedback at the application or screening stage but know that your application was reviewed and considered carefully. We wish you the best of luck with your application and maybe we’ll be celebrating your new role at ClearBank soon! Equal Opportunities ClearBank is committed to ensuring equal opportunities throughout every stage of the recruitment process. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet. We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel. Our work covers search, supply from carriers and the booking experience, all in service of our purpose of empowering greener travel choices and connecting people and places. We are a collaborative group who enjoy learning from our customers and from each other. This is a brand new role, created to own what happens once a customer has found the right journey and moves towards booking: reservation details, optional extras and payment. Because it sits so close to the point of purchase, it offers a direct line to customer experience and revenue, and plenty of room to grow. Run quick cycles of experimentation by forming hypotheses, testing ideas, learning from the results and iterating, while shaping a longer-term vision and roadmap for the booking journey. Use customer insight and data to understand where people hesitate or leave, and decide where to invest limited team capacity across each step of the journey. Build a deep understanding of how rail works in different markets and with different carriers. Decide when a market or carrier specific improvement is the right investment, and when to bring ideas and learnings together across markets so that value grows for customers everywhere, rather than staying in one place. Balance wider business goals from other teams, such as adding new supply, increasing booking features for each carrier, and introducing optional extras and new revenue streams, against keeping the journey simple and low in friction for customers. Partner closely with the Supply, Search, New Business, and Payments platform teams, alongside design, data and engineering, to align priorities and deliver improvements together. We'd love to hear from you if you have...🔍 Experience improving conversion in a digital booking, checkout or purchase journey, using data to spot opportunities and measure the impact of your changes. Confidence setting direction for a product area, balancing near-term improvements with a longer-term vision. Clear, thoughtful communication, with the ability to explain complex trade-offs and build alignment between teams who may have different priorities. Comfort weighing limited capacity against competing demands, and explaining what you will focus on and why. title: Member of Technical Staff, Simulated Universes
description: Our mission is to make first contact with superintelligence. We are creating a superlearner that discovers all knowledge from its own experience, from elementary motor skills through to profound intellectual breakthroughs. This superlearning capability - the ability to endlessly discover knowledge and skills, without relying on human data - will be driven by the world’s most powerful reinforcement learning algorithms. The superlearner is expected to rediscover and then transcend the greatest inventions in human history, such as language, science, mathematics and technology. If successful, this will represent a scientific breakthrough of comparable magnitude to Darwin: where his law explained all life, our law will explain and build all intelligence. Role brief Intelligence cannot emerge in a void. It needs a place to grow and flourish. As a Simulated Universes Engineer, you’ll help us craft, shape and maintain the worlds in which superlearners can emerge and thrive. That means making those worlds accurate, reliable and intricate, and scaling them to unprecedented highs in terms of both parallelism and speed. It’s a challenging quest and one that’s critical to our mission. In this role, you will: Build the engineering foundations of our new environments; designing, implementing and maintaining them as they grow Partner closely with the team creating the blueprints for the worlds we need to build Close the loop between blueprint and build, enabling fast, iterative research cycles Scale the environments up, while utilising state-of-the-art hardware About you You’re an engineer with a passion for creating artificial worlds, and you know what it takes to make them emerge at scale. You may be a good fit if you: Bring industry experience with large-scale simulations , whether in demanding scientific domains or in the games industry Know how to build systems like huge distributed MMOs that rely on world parallelism, large-scale physics engines, or logic that preserves consistency despite decentralised computation Turn ambitious research visions into reality by designing, building and maintaining codebases that support fast research iteration and efficient execution Enjoy working closely with researchers and/or "designers", taking their blueprints and turning them into worlds that agents can explore and learn On the pure engineering side, you’ll likely have experience with the following: Physics engines GPU-accelerated physics and simulation frameworks, such as NVIDIA Warp Lower level languages such as Rust, C or C++ Implementation of distributed server-client architectures Writing efficient GPU code We move fast, give people real ownership and trust engineers to make good judgment calls. We are a team that cares as much about doing this well as doing it fast. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. In this role, you will specialize in backend development, designing and optimizing robust microservices to ensure scalability, security, and reliability. You will support full-stack efforts, collaborate with cross-functional teams on payments, fraud detection, and compliance initiatives, and contribute to the creation of a high-scale financial products platform. description: About Keyrock Since 2017, Keyrock has been a change-maker in digital assets. Modelling & Analytical Skills: Demonstrated ability to design and implement risk models, including tail risk estimation, scenario analysis, stress testing frameworks and dependence modelling across asset classes. Crypto-Specific Risk Understanding: Practical knowledge of crypto-specific risks, including exchange/custodian risk, smart contract risk, protocol risk, funding/basis dynamics and collateral management in both centralized and decentralized environments. title: Commercial Partnerships & Events Manager
description: About Adclear At Adclear, we're building the trust layer for how the world's most regulated companies bring products to market. Every bank, lender and investment platform runs into the same invisible pain: compliance review that slows down every campaign, every launch, every idea. We're turning the function that has always said 'no' into infrastructure that says 'yes, and here's how'. Founded in 2024, we already work with leading innovators and established enterprises including Monzo, Lloyds, PensionBee, Kraken and Coinbase. We've raised 2.6m and we're scaling fast. Now we need someone to take our name into the rooms where our buyers are, and turn those rooms into pipeline. The role Field marketing and partnerships are two of the biggest levers in how Adclear goes to market. Our breakfasts, dinners and panels are where compliance and marketing leaders from banks, lenders and fintechs meet us, meet each other, and see what modern compliance looks like. Our partnerships with compliance bodies, industry voices and marketing institutions carry our name into conversations we're not yet part of. This role owns both, and is measured on what they produce commercially: the right people in the room, warm conversations handed to sales, and opportunities in the pipeline. Running a great event matters, but it's the starting point, not the job. We run around three events a quarter. You'll decide who we need to reach, build the event or partnership that gets us in front of them, fill it, work the room, and make sure the conversations turn into meetings. This is an early-stage seat. You'll be a team of one on this, working directly with the founders and commercial team, and you'll pick up whatever it takes to make go-to-market work, even when it isn't strictly on the brief. Have a look at our LinkedIn and socials to see what we already do, then imagine what you'd do with it. What you'll do Field marketing Own the field marketing calendar: around three events a quarter across breakfasts, dinners and panels, plus third-party events and conferences where our buyers already gather. Start from the pipeline, not the venue: agree with the founders and sales which accounts and personas each event is for, and design the theme and format to land with them. Fill the room with the right people. Build target lists with sales, invite personally, chase RSVPs and find another way in when the first one doesn't work. Work the room on the day: make introductions, spot buying signals and connect guests with the right person at Adclear. Turn conversations into meetings: run follow-up with sales, so every event produces booked calls and new opportunities. Get the event done well: venue, speakers, run of show, suppliers and budget, without letting logistics become the job. Create the assets yourself where it's quicker: invites, event graphics and social posts. Partnerships Own relationships with compliance bodies, industry influencers and marketing institutions, from first outreach to co-hosted events, joint content and referrals. Prioritise partners by commercial value: who gives us access to the buyers and accounts we want. Spot and pitch new partnership opportunities, and negotiate what each side gets out of it. Commercial impact Track what each event and partnership produces: who came, meetings booked, pipeline created, deals influenced. Report back to the founders and use the numbers to decide what we do more of, change, or stop. Pitch in across go-to-market wherever you can add value, from campaigns to content to sales support. What we're looking for Startup or scale-up experience. You've worked in a small, fast-moving team where you wore several hats and got things done without a big budget or a support team behind you. Commercial instinct. You think in terms of accounts, pipeline and outcomes. You know the difference between a full room and a room full of buyers, and you care about the second. Hustle. You don't wait for RSVPs to arrive. You chase, follow up, and find another way in. Confident with senior people. You're comfortable walking up to a Head of Compliance at a bank, starting a real conversation, and making the right introduction. You can plan an event, write the invite, design the graphic, negotiate with a partner and update the CRM, sometimes all in the same day. Organised under pressure. There's always one event being planned, one being filled and one being followed up. You keep them all moving. Ownership. You treat every event and partnership as yours, including the results. How we work London, 4 days a week in our Farringdon office. Founders are closely involved day to day, and you'll work directly with them and the commercial team. You own your events and partnerships from day one, including the results. Your wins will be visible and celebrated across the company and the market. This isn't the right role if you want a fixed lane or a strict 40-hour week. Events mean the occasional early breakfast and late dinner. title: Systems Simulation & Performance Modelling - Member of Technical Staff
description: About Us We’re living through a Cambrian explosion of intelligence: new models and new chips, each specialised for different tasks, are arriving all at once. The result is a new era for AI, one of radical heterogeneity. Callosum is the Intelligent Systems Company. We believe the next generation of AI won't be defined by any single model or chip, but by intelligent systems in which hardware and intelligence co-evolve. We are building the infrastructure that unifies heterogeneous compute across the full stack. This opens a new axis of scaling intelligence: a dynamic system that tailors itself to what each workload actually needs, whether that's speed, cost, precision, or whatever unit comes next. The last era scaled on a different bet: one bigger model, more of the same chip, more data. That bet is running into structural limits. Frontier models offer extraordinary capability at unsustainable cost, one that today's monolithic infrastructure was never designed to serve. Our founding principle is that intelligence comes from many specialised systems working together, not from any single component. We build the software orchestration layer that co-evolves models, workflows and silicon into one system, delivering inference tailored to every workload, and demonstrating orders-of-magnitude leaps in capability and cost. Because our software spans the full stack, our engineering team works directly with heterogeneous accelerators and frontier silicon, including Cerebras, d-Matrix, Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Normal Computing, Tenstorrent, GreatSky, and Mixx. We are not stopping at today's chips: each new generation of silicon unlocks algorithms that couldn't run before, and we intend to be first to them, every time. If we get it right, it will belong to everyone building on it - not to any single vendor. In our latest funding round, we raised $100M, led by Atomico with participation from Plural, DCVC and the UK Sovereign AI Fund’s first investment. With this, we are building the infrastructure for the next era of intelligence. We are engineers and scientists based in London, working across the full depth of the stack. We are curious, intellectually honest, and building what doesn't exist yet. If you thrive on uncharted territory and are energised by the scale of the challenge, we'd love to hear from you. About the Role Callosum believes that scaling heterogeneous AI infrastructure requires understanding how emerging hardware will behave as part of larger computational systems. Performance characteristics measured on individual accelerators rarely translate directly to distributed deployments, where networking, memory, and execution strategies introduce new constraints. We are developing simulation infrastructure that allows us to explore these interactions and evaluate future systems before they exist. This role advances the simulation and performance modelling tools that inform Callosum's hardware and infrastructure decisions. You will extend models that project device-level performance to rack-scale systems, explore alternative hardware configurations and execution strategies, and provide experimental environments for automated optimisation. The work also encompasses profiling, workload tracing, and performance instrumentation, connecting measurements from real systems to accurate and useful models of those we want to build. What You'll Build Extend our simulators to predict heterogeneous compute performance from individual accelerators to multi-rack deployments. Model networking, memory, and execution behaviour to evaluate alternative system architectures and configurations. Develop profiling, tracing, and workload capture tools that inform and validate simulation models. Extend simulation environments for rapid experimentation and automated optimisation of systems and algorithms. Characterise emerging accelerator architectures and translate hardware measurements into predictive models of system-level performance. What Sets You Apart Strong experience in systems simulation, performance modelling, or performance-critical systems software. Deep understanding of computer architecture, distributed systems, or high-performance computing. Familiarity with profiling, tracing, instrumentation, and methods for characterising computational workloads. Strong systems programming experience, ideally including C++ or Rust. Ability to reason about modelling accuracy, abstraction, and trade-offs between simulation fidelity and computational cost. What We Offer Competitive Salary, determined by skills and experience Equity & Ownership Private healthcare We offer Visa sponsorship and relocation benefits to hire the best in the world We work in person at our London office. You'll have the tools, space and setup to do your best work, and if you have specific needs, just tell us We're committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome, and believe in equal opportunities for all. Develop automated methods for discovering, characterising, and optimising hardware-specialised model variants. Build evaluation methods that measure model quality and establish the trade-offs introduced by hardware-aware adaptations. Experience in model architecture research, efficient inference, or hardware-aware machine learning. Familiarity with a range of architectures, such as mixture-of-experts, diffusion, JEPA, or alternative attention mechanisms. Strong intuition for the interactions between model capability, numerical behaviour, memory requirements, and execution efficiency. And that’s why we’ve built <strong>OpenDoor </strong>for<strong> Amazon</strong>.</p> <p><strong>OpenDoor</strong> is a unique integration of the best of WPP and Amazon – building on their respective strengths and visions. Whether at WPP or at Amazon, every project is an OpenDoor on new possibilities. Anything and everything can be an opportunity for our people to drive <em>impact</em> – for them to innovate, learn, thrive, and occasionally fail too.</p> <p>The unique OpenDoor partnership model is built to deliver next level Productivity, fueled by our industry-leading approach to People, Platforms, and Process. OpenDoor spans across all WPP agencies and disciplines such as media, business consultancy, communications and brand strategy, tech and commerce, public relations, and production.</p> <p>OpenDoor’s values are built from Amazon’s own <a href="https://www.amazon.jobs/content/en/our-workplace/leadership-principles"><strong>16 Leadership Principles</strong></a>, and WPP’s core values of Open, Optimistic and Extraordinary. Together, when WPP’s Creative Transformation meets Amazon’s next-level customer centricity, our people come together to challenge and impact what’s done today and build a better future.</p> <p>By joining OpenDoor, not only are you joining a cross-function team partnering with one of WPP’s top five global clients, but you are also taking a step to challenge yourself and the world around you every day, working in the most unusual way on some of Earth’s most ambitious opportunities in marketing, tech, media, business, and creativity.</p> <p>ABOUT THE ROLE</p> <p>We are searching for a talented and enthusiastic individual to join our Amazon MGM International team as a Senior Client Executive. This is a full-time position based in London. The Role will report to the Client Director. This is an incredibly exciting time to join the team, as we scale and begin to work across a fantastic and varied film slate, with titles such as Hail Mary, Verity and The Thomas Crown Affair.</p> <p>This role assists in the oversight of all workstreams and helps to co-ordinate the delivery of projects from start to finish, working with our internal teams and local market colleagues to deliver excellence in execution.</p> <p>RESPONSIBILITIES</p> <p>Work with the OpenDoor and WPP network will be a key part of your day-to-day and enabling best practice and on-time delivery is critical.</p> prepared</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Excellent organization and project planning skills.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills and a data-driven mindset.</li> Each team is custom-built around a client’s specific needs and challenges, providing easy access to the right capabilities. And that’s why we’ve built <strong>OpenDoor </strong>for<strong> Amazon</strong>.</p> <p><strong>OpenDoor</strong> is a unique integration of the best of WPP and Amazon – building on their respective strengths and visions. Whether at WPP or at Amazon, every project is an OpenDoor on new possibilities. Anything and everything can be an opportunity for our people to drive <em>impact</em> – for them to innovate, learn, thrive, and occasionally fail too.</p> <p>The OpenDoor partnership model is designed to deliver next-level productivity through an industry-leading approach to people, platforms and processes. OpenDoor brings together WPP agencies and disciplines including media, business consultancy, communications and brand strategy, technology and commerce, public relations and production.</p> <p>OpenDoor’s values draw on Amazon’s <a href="https://www.amazon.jobs/content/en/our-workplace/leadership-principles"><strong>16 Leadership Principles</strong></a> and WPP’s values of Open, Optimistic and Extraordinary. Together, WPP’s creative transformation and Amazon’s customer focus empower our people to challenge today’s conventions and build a better future.</p> <p>By joining OpenDoor, you will become part of a cross-functional team partnering with one of WPP’s top five global clients. You will work in new ways on ambitious opportunities across marketing, technology, media, business and creativity.</p> <p>ABOUT THE ROLE</p> <p>We are looking for a talented and enthusiastic individual to join our OpenDoor team as a Client Senior Executive. This full-time, London-based role reports to the Regional Client Associate Director and supports XCM, Amazon’s Cross-Channel Marketing division. The position sits within a regional team that works remotely across the UK and Germany, with the line manager based in DE and regular collaboration with colleagues and local market teams across Europe. The Client Senior Executive coordinates campaigns and workstreams from briefing to delivery, helping to ensure consistent client service, robust operations and high-quality execution.</p> <p>XCM is Amazon’s Cross-Channel Marketing division, delivering communications for Amazon.com, including major campaigns such as Black Friday and Prime Day. OpenDoor is XCM’s media partner worldwide, excluding North America and Latin America. As Europe is the largest region supported by the WPP team, the Regional XCM Client Senior Executive plays an important role in coordinating consistent delivery across markets.</p> quality and consistency.</li> <li>Identify and share best-in-class work from across the network, helping regional clients and local markets adopt effective approaches.</li> <li>Contribute to a positive, collaborative team environment and work with the line manager to set objectives aligned with the role and agency vision.</li> </ul> <p>QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE</p> <ul> <li>2–3 years’ experience in media planning, client management or account coordination, preferably within a network agency.</li> <li>Excellent organisational and project planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills and a data-driven mindset, with close attention to detail.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with and Leadership Principles.</li> <li>Understanding of cross-channel media planning and how individual channels contribute to an integrated plan.</li> </ul> <p>BENEFITS OF OPENDOOR</p> <ul> VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.</p></div><p><strong>Solution Architect (Permanent) </strong>with commerce experience wanted to join our Solution Archtiecture team, here at VML Enterprise Solutions </p> <p><strong>The opportunity:</strong></p> <p>A Solution Architect is required for a high-profile role giving the successful applicant the chance to lead the solution architecture for some of the world’s largest online brands and retailers and be an integral part of our talented and expanding Solution Architecture team.</p> <p>You will be responsible for creating and assuring solution architecture using a wide range of technologies, from SaaS eCommerce platforms through to client-specific cloud solutions. You’ll develop relationships with key client-side stakeholders in charge of IT and digital strategy and architecture, and you’ll work closely with our internal delivery teams to ensure your architecture vision is realised</p> <p>Our Solution Architecture team not only focus on delivery but also work with our clients in delivering the best consulting advice to ensure world class solutions that enable our clients to transact more digitally.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll be doing:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Working on large-scale digital transformation programmes with global clients, designing solutions for all the opportunity and complexity this brings</li> <li>Own the solution architecture, document it, and communicate that architecture to a wide range of audiences</li> <li>See out and considerations for a distributed eCommerce architecture and apply this knowledge to your solutions</li> <li>Understand the level at which solution architecture applies, and help transition your solutions to application and cloud architects and technical leads</li> <li>Make and justify key architectural decisions considering all relevant constraints</li> <li>Follow the principles and guidance set out by the Solution Architecture team</li> <li>Contribute to the initiatives of our Solution Architecture team, including developing common patterns for new technologies and developing PoCs against industry trends.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we want from you: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Core understanding of the capabilities of a wide range of technologies typically found within an eCommerce landscape, including enterprise eCommerce platforms and components, and apply this knowledge to your solutions</li> <li>Proven experience of solution ownership,</li> <li>Experience delivering solution transformations, roadmaps and (or) Integration strategies</li> <li>Understand the capabilities of public cloud platforms and be an advocate of cloud-native solutions</li> <li>Proven experience Designing quality solutions, often large scale and transactional in nature, for global enterprise clients</li> <li>Be client and delivery focussed, able to adapt a solution to meet additional requirements and constraints and apply pragmatism when required</li> <li>Prior experience running design workshops </li> <li>Strong stakeholder management skills </li> <li>Have excellent communication, presentation and documentation skills</li> </ul> <p><strong>If you know some of this, even better:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with OMS</li> <li>Experience with PIM</li> <li>Specific Solution Architecture experience with the following technologies:</li> <li>React, Next.js, GraphQL (incl. federated), Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Sanity.io, GCP</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we can offer you:</strong></p> <p>Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.</p> <p><strong>Permanent only:</strong></p> <p>We offer a great benefits package including a discretionary bonus scheme, training opportunities, competitive pension, medical insurance, life assurance, social events, opportunities to buy and sell holidays, family friendly policies, discounts with hundreds of retailers and much more.</p> <p>Our personality and behaviours: We believe that we are what we do, not just what we say. Our shared values and behaviours show how to bring the VML Enterprise Solution's culture to life through the actions we all take every day:</p> <ul> <li>Connect Meaningfully</li> <li>Inspire Creatively</li> <li>Include Purposefully</li> <li>Approach Positively</li> </ul> <p>Our brilliant, talented people are what makes VML Enterprise Solutions what we are. That’s why we look for people who go beyond and always push our thinking to be better than yesterday.</p> <p><strong>About VML Enterprise Solutions:</strong></p> <p>Welcome to VML Enterprise Solutions, a multi-award-winning powerhouse of innovation, creativity and growth through technology in an ever-evolving world.</p> <p>Over 7,000 employees across VML’s global offices support VML Enterprise Solutions by helping to create and deliver digital transformations, Artificial Intelligence applications and technology solutions that introduce new operational efficiencies to organisations around the world.</p> <p>Our mission is to inspire global audiences to embrace and advance the world of online and offline shopping through seamless digital experiences and tech innovation. You will turn independently evolved services into one secure, testable, and maintainable onboard platform. This is a hands-on software engineering role focused on production Python services, service architecture, messaging, and reliable operation on constrained Linux hardware, including Raspberry Pi, x86, and NVIDIA Jetson. Design stable, versioned vehicle-to-backend contracts for telemetry, commands and acknowledgements, video metadata and control, configuration, health, and logs. Engineer for unreliable connectivity: buffering and store-and-forward, idempotent commands, explicit acknowledgements and timeouts, reconnection, back-off, and safe behaviour when the backend is unreachable. Implement secure-by-default services: least-privilege identities and messaging permissions, mutually authenticated and encrypted backend links, secure credential provisioning and rotation, sandboxed runtimes, and audit events for safety-critical commands. Strengthen automated testing across unit, contract, integration, simulation, and hardware-in-the-loop tests, with CI gates that catch regressions before release. Build safer release workflows with signed packages, dependency scanning, bench smoke and soak tests, staged fleet rollouts, and reliable rollback. Profile services and enforce practical CPU, memory, and latency budgets on target hardware. Improve field diagnostics through structured logs, metrics, standardised health reporting, post-mission log capture, and actionable runbooks. Document architectural decisions and service interfaces, communicate trade-offs clearly, and use AI coding tools to accelerate delivery without compromising quality. What success looks like Actively developed onboard services converge on a shared architecture, supported Python runtime, messaging model, and service template. Engineers can take a new service from an empty repository to running on a bench vehicle in a day or less, with less duplicated infrastructure code. Vehicle-to-backend contracts remain compatible as cloud and vehicle software evolve at different speeds, preventing integration failures in the field. Authentication, least privilege, secret handling, runtime hardening, and supply-chain checks are consistently applied across the onboard stack. Automated tests and bench validation catch defects before deployment, reducing issues discovered in the field. Releases move predictably from bench validation to pilot vehicles and the wider fleet, with clear readiness gates and rollback procedures. Services stay within resource budgets and remain diagnosable under hardware constraints and degraded connectivity. Architecture documentation and runbooks help engineering, QA, and field teams integrate changes and resolve failures faster. Required Qualifications 10+ years of professional experience in software engineering , delivering and operating production systems. 2+ years as a Tech Lead or Staff Engineer , owning architecture across multiple services or teams and establishing standards adopted by others. Expert Python — designs and ships production services (asyncio, packaging, testing, profiling, and performance); Node.js experience is a plus. Distributed / edge system architecture — has designed service architectures and messaging systems (e.g., NATS, MQTT, ZMQ, Kafka) with versioned contracts across system boundaries and unreliable networks. Web development and API experience — has built and evolved HTTP/WebSocket APIs and message-based integrations for multiple consumers. Security architecture — has led the design of authentication and authorisation, secrets and key management, secure updates, and supply-chain controls; security reviews or certification evidence are a strong plus. Quality engineering leadership — has established test strategies, CI gates, and staged release pipelines for a team or organisation; simulator or hardware-in-the-loop experience is a strong plus. Development with AI tools — uses AI coding assistants or agents daily and has introduced practices that help a team use them effectively and safely. C++, Rust, or Go experience is a plus. UxV, robotics, or embedded/edge Linux experience (e.g., MAVLink, GStreamer, serial/CAN devices, systemd services on constrained hardware) is a plus. The nature of combat has changed. About the role Support Engineering is the technical layer between frontline Support and Engineering. You’ll take on complex issues involving integrations, APIs, permissions, data, reporting, migrations, and workflows—using application behavior, logs, databases, and customer context to determine whether an issue can be resolved through Support or represents a product defect. You’ll investigate issues end to end using tools such as Plain, GitHub, Datadog, databases, and the codebase. You won’t write the fix; you’ll give Engineering a well-validated escalation with reproduction steps, relevant evidence, customer impact, and a root-cause hypothesis when possible. You’ll also identify recurring issues, improve documentation and enablement, and partner with Product and Engineering on improvements. As an early Support Engineer in EMEA, you’ll establish regional operating practices and handoff norms across European time zones while bringing EMEA customer patterns to a global team. Build trusted working relationships with frontline Support, Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and customers. Identify recurring problems and turn them into documentation, enablement, tooling, process improvements, or product feedback. Partner with Product and Engineering on recurring product improvements by synthesizing customer patterns, validating defects, and sharing the technical context needed to choose between a product change, documentation, tooling, or process improvement. Establish EMEA coverage, handoff, and operating practices across European time zones while bringing regional customer patterns to the global Support Engineering team. Track and improve the outcomes that matter: resolution speed, escalation quality, fewer avoidable Engineering escalations, frontline self-sufficiency, reduced customer effort, and customer confidence. You should apply if: You’ve worked in a hands-on, customer-centric technical role where you independently investigate ambiguous issues involving APIs, integrations, logs, data, and application behavior. You’re comfortable moving between customer conversations, APIs, logs, databases, product behavior, and code-level context to find root causes. You can distinguish a configuration, data, documentation, or enablement issue from a true product defect—and explain your reasoning clearly. You write precise investigations that others can quickly understand and act on, and communicate thoughtfully with technical and non-technical audiences across time zones. You naturally look beyond the immediate ticket and improve the systems around it through documentation, enablement, tooling, or process design. You want to be an early technical owner for EMEA and are energized by building regional structure within a global team. Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness. Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation. This role sits at the center of Notion’s workflow-led GTM motion. You will partner directly with customers to understand their business goals, operating processes, technical environment, governance needs, and adoption barriers, then translate that context into scalable Notion architectures that drive measurable value. You will be hands-on across discovery, solution design, workspace architecture, workflow build, AI implementation, launch planning, adoption and handoff. You will work deeply with customers to define what Notion should own, where it should integrate with existing systems, and how Notion can become a durable operating layer for their teams. The best candidates combine strong consultative discovery, systems thinking, technical fluency, AI-native workflow design, implementation judgment and exceptional customer presence. You should be comfortable reasoning through technical tradeoffs, designing scalable solutions, and partnering closely with Forward Deployed Engineering when deeper engineering support is required. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Partner with customers on forward deployed engagements from discovery through launch, translating business goals and workflow requirements into scalable clear solution design and Notion solutions that drive durable adoption. - Design scalable Notion architectures that translate customer workflows, permission and governance needs, integrations and AI use cases into optimal workspaces that are easy to adopt, manage and scale. - Design and deploy AI-native workflows using Notion AI, custom agents, automations, Workers, Developer Platform capabilities and adjacent AI tools, partnering with Forward Deployed Engineering when advanced technical depth is needed for migrations, API constraints, security architecture or frontier implementation. - Help customers navigate change by designing adoption plans, enablement materials and launch approaches that drive sustained usage and measurable business value. - Identify repeatable patterns across customer engagements and convert them into packaged solutions, templates, reference architectures, run books, enablement assets and product feedback. - Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, simplifying complex technical requirements, making practical tradeoff recommendations and helping stakeholders align around a clear implementation path. - Partner cross-functionally with GTM, Product, Engineering, PMM, Services leadership and the partner ecosystem to scale what works beyond individual customer engagements. - Create clear implementation plans, handoff materials and success measures that align customers and internal teams on the path to value. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - 5+ years of experience in tech services/consulting, solutions architecture, implementation, customer engineering, or a similar customer-facing role. - Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer goals into clear workflows, implementation plans, solution architectures, and measurable success criteria. - Strong consultative discovery skills, including the ability to map current-state workflows, identify customer pain, understand operating models, surface technical constraints, and define practical future-state solutions. - Hands-on AI builder mindset, with experience using AI tools to design, prototype, automate, or improve real business workflows. - Technical fluency with APIs, integrations, data models, automation, enterprise systems, developer workflows and implementation tradeoffs. You do not need to write production code but you should be able to reason through technical constraints and troubleshoot effectively. - Strong experience delivering implementations that drive adoption, change management and long-term customer value. - Strong project and engagement management skills, including ownership of scope, timeline, deliverables, stakeholder alignment, risks, decisions, dependencies and launch readiness. - Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for business, technical, and executive audiences. - Strong executive presence and customer judgment, with the ability to build trust, frame tradeoffs clearly, and move ambiguous decisions forward. - Bias toward action, high learning velocity, and comfort building in fast-changing AI-native product environments. NICE TO HAVES: - Experience designing or deploying Agents, automations or AI-powered workflows with Customers. - Experience with Notion, APIs, MCPs, Workers, coding agents or developer platform workflows. - Experience developing discovery methodologies, reusable delivery assets, internal tooling, packaged services or reference architectures from the ground up. - Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to turn field learnings into roadmap signal, reusable architecture patterns or scalable product improvements. - Previous experience in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment. As we expand we need to make sure we can support our businesses and control our processes, so we are growing our team to meet these exciting new challenges! We are looking to introduce a Senior Financial Control Analyst on a 9 Month Fixed Term Contract. </p> <p>Our team sits within Monzo’s Finance collective and our job is getting the numbers right. We’re currently a team of seven qualified accountants, split between our Cardiff and London offices, and we ensure the ledger’s correct at every month-end. We work closely with all areas of Finance and the product teams to make that happen.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by… </strong></p> <p>We're looking for a proactive, enthusiastic and commercially-minded accountant to work on our financial accounting, and help us build a world-class finance function. This role would be well suited to a qualified accountant with 2+ years of post-qualification experience.</p> <p>We have some really exciting challenges under way like making sure we maximise our new SAP S4/HANA general ledger, expanding into the European Union, pushing forward with our automation plans, continuing to grow our customer base, growing our lending business and adding to our marketplace. You’ll work on scaling Monzo in a controlled way, while helping us optimise our financial control processes with the help of technology. You’ll report to our Financial Control Manager.</p> <p><strong>Your day-to-day:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage a tight process with the rest of our internal Finance team to ensure a swift month-end close process and group consolidation.</li> <li>Understand the business and our products to write insightful management commentary.</li> <li>Understand our accounting systems and make sure we are taking advantage of all features we can to minimise manual elements of reporting.</li> <li>Embrace the opportunity to improve and transform processes, driving incremental improvements through to adoption of AI.</li> <li>Learn SQL skills to run reports and propose solutions that make our processes efficient and scalable.</li> <li>Support our year end process working with external auditors and our Financial Reporting squad.</li> <li>Help review new products, assessing the accounting and implementing them in our banking platform and accounting system.</li> <li>Work with the business to assess the impact of changes in accounting standards and make proposals on accounting policy matters for new products launched.</li> <li>Help maintain the integrity of our chart of accounts and financial static data.</li> <li>Resolve miscellaneous inquiries and support the overall finance team wherever needed - from forecasting and valuations, to bank transfers, transfer pricing and tax policy research!</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You’re a qualified accountant with a few years’ post-qualification experience, ideally in financial reporting/controlling teams and working in a retail banking environment</li> <li>You have a strong understanding of technical accounting standards</li> <li>You have a great eye for detail</li> <li>You’re fascinated by the banking and regulatory landscape, and have a good understanding of key financial controls</li> <li>You’re a self-starter and enjoy tackling what needs doing, whether it’s making a bank transfer or pulling together reports for investors</li> <li>You’re comfortable translating complex information into simple words for people with diverse backgrounds</li> <li>You’re interested in using data (SQL skills would be a bonus)</li> <li>You embrace change and are motivated to improve and innovate process</li> <li>You thrive in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment</li> <li>What we’re doing at Monzo excites you!</li> </ul> <p>🙌 What’s in it for you</p> <p>💰£56,000 - £75,000. </p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London or Cardiff office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more!<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recruiter Screening Conversation </li> <li>Initial HM Interview </li> <li>Role Specific Interview </li> <li>Behavioural Interview </li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read them here.</a></p> <p>#LI-TP1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. Mission. Action. Growth. Inclusion. Care.</p> <p>It's at the heart of everything we do. Within our People Collective, we're here to bring brilliant people together, build an inclusive culture and create an environment where everyone can do their best work. As Monzo continues to grow, our offices play an important role in bringing our people together. They're more than just places to work. They're spaces where teams connect, collaborate and experience what it means to be a Monzonaut.</p> <p>We're looking for an experienced <strong>Property & Facilities Lead</strong> to join us on a 12 month fixed term contract, covering caregiver leave. You'll lead a team of six across four office locations in London, Cardiff, Dublin and Barcelona, helping us deliver an exceptional workplace experience while managing and developing our global property portfolio.</p> <p>Reporting to the Head of Property, Culture and Engagement, you'll oversee our daily operations, lead strategic projects and collaborate with teams across Monzo to create safe, welcoming and engaging workplaces that bring people together and put the Monzonaut community first.</p> <h2><strong>🔑 You'll play a key role by...</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>🏢 Leading our global property and facilities operations</strong> – Overseeing our office locations, ensuring they're safe and compliant, while delivering a consistent and delightful workplace experience.</li> <li><strong>🚀 Managing and delivering property projects</strong> – Leading projects from planning to delivery, including office moves, refurbishments and new site launches. You'll manage timelines, budgets and internal and external stakeholders to deliver successful outcomes.</li> <li><strong>🌍 Supporting our global property strategy</strong> – Turning our longer term property ambitions into practical plans, ensuring our spaces meet the needs of our people and support Monzo's continued growth.</li> <li><strong>💪 Leading and developing a brilliant team</strong> – Managing six team members across all locations, setting clear priorities, supporting their development and building a scalable, high-performing function.</li> <li><strong>🤝 Collaborating across Monzo</strong> – Building strong relationships with Finance, Legal, TechOps and senior leadership to align priorities, influence decisions and deliver improvements.</li> <li><strong>💰 Managing budgets and suppliers</strong> – Overseeing property and facilities budgets, managing supplier relationships and ensuring we're delivering value for money across our portfolio.</li> <li><strong>🦺 Keeping our spaces safe and sustainable</strong> – Ensuring our workplaces meet health and safety requirements, managing compliance and working with the ESG team to deliver our Scope 1 and 2 environmental commitments.</li> <li><strong>✨ Continuously improving how we work</strong> – Using data and employee feedback to improve our spaces, streamline processes and build scalable ways of working. You'll also be happy to roll up your sleeves and provide hands on support when needed.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>🤩 We'd love to hear from you if...</strong></h2> <ul> <li>You have strong <strong>property and facilities management experience</strong>, ideally in a fast-paced, growing organisation with multiple office locations.</li> <li>You're an <strong>experienced project manager</strong>, confident leading complex projects end to end, managing timelines, budgets, risks and competing priorities.</li> <li>You're a <strong>confident people leader</strong>, with experience managing, coaching and developing high performing teams.</li> <li>You're <strong>commercially minded</strong>, with experience managing budgets, suppliers and contracts while balancing cost, quality and employee experience.</li> <li>You're a <strong>strong communicator and collaborator</strong>, comfortable working with senior stakeholders and building relationships across teams.</li> <li>You're <strong>proactive, organised and adaptable</strong>, able to balance day-to-day operations with strategic priorities, navigate ambiguity and make decisions independently.</li> <li>You're <strong>data-driven</strong>, and can use insights to make decisions and improve processes.</li> <li>You have a good understanding of <strong>workplace health and safety</strong>, and are confident using digital tools such as Google Workspace and Slack</li> <li>[Nice to have] You have a formal health and safety, facilities and/or project  management qualification such as IWFM 7, NVQ, NEBOSH, PRINCE 2 or APM.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Not ticking every box? That's totally okay! </strong>We know that some people are less likely to apply for a role unless they meet every requirement. At Monzo, we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive team, and we care just as much about your potential as your experience. If you're excited about this opportunity and think you could make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.</p> <h2><strong>🙌 What's in it for you</strong></h2> <p>💰 £60k - £65k + Incentive Awards</p> <p>📍 This role is based in our London office, with a minimum of three days per week in the office. You'll also travel periodically to our Cardiff, Dublin and Barcelona offices.</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to manage your time in a way that works for you, your team and the role.</p> <p>📚 £1,000 annual learning budget to spend on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We'll provide you with a MacBook and the equipment you need to work effectively.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more!<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <h2><strong>🌈 The application journey</strong></h2> <p>Our hiring process is designed to help us get to know you, your experience and how you approach real-world challenges.</p> <p>There are four stages:</p> <ol> <li><strong>Initial call</strong> – An initial conversation to learn more about you and share more about the opportunity.</li> <li><strong>Role-specific interview</strong> – A deeper conversation about your technical experience, project management and approach to leading a multi-site function.</li> <li><strong>Manager and leadership interview</strong> – An opportunity to explore your leadership style, stakeholder management and how you approach decision-making.</li> </ol> <p>We aim to complete the process in around 2–3 weeks and will be as flexible as possible to accommodate your schedule.</p> <p>We also have some guidance on using AI during your application and interview.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read it here.</a></p> <p>#LI-OH #LI-LONDON</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. description: At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires. Over the past few years, Linear has experienced incredible organic growth and has become the default tool of choice for many of the world’s best product teams. 300;"><span style="font-weight: 300;">Reliable, delivering high quality work that builds trust and confidence.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 300;"><span style="font-weight: 300;">Accessible, character.</span></li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Leadership ability</li> <li>Software or tech industry experience</li> <li>Public company finance and reporting SQL and Python are our desired coding languages but experience in SAS/R will be considered.
